issues.explanation: Change adds four password routes, verification route, mail theme, translations, controllers and views with no Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating TDD no-production-code-without-a-test rule.
PasswordResetController::update validates three fields with a complex PasswordRule inline instead of using a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.

conventions.evidence: No test files in change.diff despite TDD mandate; PasswordResetController.php:138-146 validates token+email+password inline with PasswordRule instead of a Form Request; CHANGELOG.md:26 kept in sync.

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetController.php:98-101,107-120,126-131,136-167 small focused create/store/edit/update methods with PHPDoc; app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:50-71 clear __invoke with explicit 403 checks.

requirements.evidence: All contract met: .env.example APP_NAME=PegaFila APP_LOCALE=pt_BR, phpunit.xml pins, config/mail.php:215-221 theme pegafila, pegafila.css:568-574 .button-primary #0f7490, lang/pt_BR.json Reset your password and Verify your email address, routes/web.php password.request/email/reset/update + verification.verify, controllers handle always-passwords.sent/PasswordReset event/403 checks/redirect /.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task: .env.example, phpunit.xml, mail config/theme, lang entries, routes, two controllers, two auth views, User MustVerifyEmail, CHANGELOG; no login/registration/Livewire/UI or infra changes.

security.evidence: VerifyEmailController.php:54-60 aborts 403 on id/hash mismatch; routes/web.php:640-657 guest-only password routes, auth+signed+throttle:6,1 verification; PasswordResetController.php:109-119 validates email and always returns passwords.sent; views use {{ }} only.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Password::sendResetLink, Password::reset with Hash/Str/Event, default VerifyEmail route convention, and stock mail theme copy with brand color; no new services, layers or abstractions.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains zero files under tests/ and no Pest/PHPUnit cases for password.request/email/reset/update, verification 403/success, or translated mail subjects/buttons.

review.summary: Delivers pt-BR password-reset and email-verification flows with pegafila mail theme, correct routes, controllers, views and lang pins. Functionally correct and secure, but ships with no tests despite the TDD mandate, so it needs substantial rework to add coverage before merging.
